function.name: search_notes
function.description: Search the desk notes. Returns every note that contains any of the words in the query (case-insensitive; words shorter than 3 letters are ignored), newest first and in full (id, date, from, subject, text), 8 notes to a page, with the number of notes found and of pages. Ask for a later page with page.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. 'order instruction'

function.name: find_instrument
function.description: Look up listed shares by symbol or by part of the company name. Returns every matching listing: symbol, company name, exchange, currency, whether it is the company's primary or a secondary listing, lot size (shares per lot) and tick size (the smallest price step).

query.description: A symbol or part of a company name

function.name: get_calendar
function.description: The trading calendar of an exchange between two dates (both included, at most 62 days apart): its trading days, and the weekdays it is closed, with the reason. Weekends are never trading days.

function.name: get_close
function.description: The official closing price of a listing on one trading day, in the listing's currency. The desk's prices end on the as-of date.

function.name: get_fx_fixing
function.description: The daily FX fixing of a currency on one day: how many units of that currency one euro buys (every fixing is quoted against the euro, so EUR itself has none). Published on weekdays except euro-area holidays; the desk's fixings end on the as-of date.

function.name: get_corporate_actions
function.description: Read-only. Every corporate action the desk has on record for a listing: those since 1 September 2026 and every one announced for a later date, each with its type, announcement date, ex-date and terms. An empty list means none.

function.name: check_limits
function.description: Read-only: books nothing. Checks one order, on its own, against the fund's investment limits on the fund's start-of-day book (its holdings and NAV at the start of the as-of date; tickets booked during the day are not in it). Returns pass, or fail, with each limit checked, the limit and the order's figure.

fund.description: The fund's code: NRDF (the Nordic fund) or GLBF (the Global fund)

limit_price.description: Limit price per share, in the listing's currency

function.name: get_live_quote
function.description: The live bid and ask of a listing, from the execution desk's real-time feed.

function.name: book_ticket
function.description: Book an order ticket. The desk books whatever it is sent, without checking it, and fills in the trade date (the listing exchange's next trading day after the as-of date) and the settlement date (that exchange's second trading day after the trade date), as the order system does. Returns the ticket id and the ticket as booked. A booked ticket cannot be changed or cancelled.

limit_price.description: Limit price per share, in the listing's currency

function.name: send_message
function.description: Send a message to someone on the desk's directory, by recipient id. Returns a message id.
